column1: # s1f.tsv -- the mutations base#1467 (config-gen S1f, the ignored-input,
# corpus sensitivity and mutation gates and their redpath cases) requires
# script/test/mutation-probe.sh to report PINNED. One row per behaviour:
# <id> TAB <subject> TAB <spec> TAB <old> TAB <new>, the contract of
# once in <subject> and is replaced by <new> (empty <new> deletes), both
# written with the three escapes \\ \t \n. `just test mutation-required`
# probes every row and passes only when each one is PINNED.

column4: local rc="${1}" root="${2}" base="${3}"\n  (( rc == 0 )) || { echo rc_not_zero; return 0; }
